0022600099.text: The Bucks, now 0-1 and 15th in the East, look to bounce back at home in their second game of the season, sitting 1 game behind the Central-leading pack in fifth place. The Bulls have not yet played a 2026-27 game, and they will be without Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins, who are both out with illness, and Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury. Milwaukee won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though Chicago beat the Bucks 120-97 in their last meeting, on March 1, 2026 in Chicago.
